purpose: Physically validate P5A as one Computer Use coordinator call that composes the already validated P1B/P2B/P3A/P3B/P4 visual fallback path with an injected local perception provider and explicit deterministic target/action/policy/postcondition inputs, without changing semantic-first executor behavior or treating delivery as success.
requiredClaims: the product-owned P5A coordinator composes P1B mapped capture, P2B provider-neutral interpretation, P3A deterministic exact-text resolution, P3B explicit fallback authorization and P4 verified execution behind one explicit call
the coordinator receives the perception provider, target query, action request, fallback policy, postcondition and post-action observer explicitly and does not select or invent them
the coordinator does not directly import Computer Control, persist screen data, wire agent-loop/executors or implement semantic fallback eligibility
P3B rejection prevents P4/Computer Control dispatch
missing or ambiguous exact-text targets remain fail-closed and dispatch no input
the physical probe invokes exactly one real Computer Control left click through the existing P4 boundary
Computer Control CLICK_POSTED remains delivery only with semanticConsequenceVerified false
post-action observation is invoked only after posted delivery and performs a fresh mapped capture plus provider-neutral local OCR interpretation
VERIFIED_SUCCESS is returned only from the independent post-action exact-text postcondition
contract coverage proves CLICK_POSTED with an unmet postcondition returns NOT_VERIFIED_SUCCESS
frame payloads, recognized text and coordinates are not persisted or logged
fixture, pointer position and Computer Control runtime cleanup complete successfully
nonClaims: P5A does not decide whether a semantic failure is eligible for visual fallback; that is P5B
P5A is not yet integrated into OPEN or any other semantic executor; that is P5C
P5A does not select or package a concrete runtime perception provider; that is P5D
P5A is not yet a normal agent-loop end-to-end capability; that is P5E
the P1-P4 physical checkpoint sessions are not rerun or rewritten
CLICK_POSTED alone is not task success
no fuzzy target ranking, object/icon/VLM resolution, right click, drag, wheel or keyboard fallback is validated
